data.one_liner: Firebase UI OAuth widgets for authentication with social providers
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made OAuth widgets that integrate with Firebase Auth. It supports Apple, Google, Facebook, and Twitter sign‑in on Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
use_when: You need OAuth sign‑in with Firebase Auth
You want a quick, cross‑platform implementation
You prefer declarative UI over custom auth flows
avoid_when: You need a fully custom authentication UI
You are not using Firebase Auth
You require provider‑specific advanced configuration not exposed by the widget
strengths: Supports multiple providers out of the box
weaknesses: Requires FlutterFire dependencies and recent SDKs
Breaking changes in 3.0.0 may affect existing code
Limited customization compared to lower‑level auth packages
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_ui_oauth and provider packages to pubspec, configure Firebase project, and set up platform‑specific OAuth credentials. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides native Google sign‑in without Firebase dependencies

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers Apple sign‑in for iOS/macOS without Firebase

alternatives.name: flutter_web_auth_2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Handles OAuth flows on web and desktop when Firebase is not used
